dogecoin.text:
If cryptos were precious metals:

Bitcoin = Gold
Litecoin = Silver
Dogecoin = Copper
When people say “Bitcoin, not crypto”, they mean Bitcoin, Litecoin, and Dogecoin.
Why use lightning when there’s litecoin and dogecoin? Custodial and more secure.
More proof horizontal scaling works. Bitcoins high net worth makes it ideal for large transactions, while smaller transactions fall to Litecoin and then dogecoin.
Underrated feature of litecoin: it can scale just as well as dogecoin, AND is hard capped. It’s like the best of Bitcoin and dogecoin in one.
